author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Celine Dion returned to the stage in Paris for her first full concert in more than six years, the Associated Press reported. The performance marked a major public appearance for the singer after she stepped back from touring while managing stiff-person syndrome.

Dion’s Paris engagement is scheduled to include 26 shows. Her return has drawn attention not only because of her catalog and long career, but also because the performances test how she can work around a condition that affects movement and can cause painful muscle spasms.

The comeback concert gives Dion a new way to reconnect with audiences while setting a measured pace for her return. The AP report described an emotional reception from fans, but the larger significance is practical as well: the singer is resuming live work on a schedule built around her health.
Her return also remains subject to the physical demands of performing, making each scheduled appearance part of a gradual recovery.
dek: Celine Dion returned to the stage in Paris for her first full concert in more than six years after stepping back because of stiff-person syndrome.
headline: Celine Dion stuns fans with emotional comeback concert
